features_verified: 1. Fix All Issues button appears in confidence review banner when safe fixes exist
2. Fix All Issues button shows count of safe fixes (e.g., '(1)', '(2)')
3. Fix All Issues button does NOT appear when no safe fixes exist (all items clean)
4. Clicking Fix All Issues opens confirmation modal with summary
5. Confirmation modal shows count of math/pack/correction fixes
6. Confirmation modal shows per-item detail with name and fix reason
7. Cancel button closes modal without applying changes
8. Apply All button applies all safe fixes in batch
9. After Apply All, fixed items revalidate and become Trusted if math now passes
10. After Apply All, items with remaining issues (e.g., missing name) stay flagged
11. After Apply All, Fix All button disappears (no more safe fixes)
12. Per-row Apply/Edit Manually/Ignore/Dismiss buttons still work independently
13. Subtotal and Total update after Apply All
critical_code_review_comments: collectSafeFixes() correctly filters by type: only 'math', 'pack', 'correction' are safe fixes
previewFixAll() builds summary with counts per fix type (math, pack, correction)
applyFixAll() applies fixes and calls revalidateItem() on each fixed item
Fix All button only appears when collectSafeFixes().length > 0
Missing name items (type='missing') are correctly excluded from safe fixes
